2608.18555.title: Performance Drift Detection in Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) for IoT Environments
2608.18555.paper_summary: Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) is a powerful cloud paradigm enabling data-driven intelligent applications in Internet of Things (IoT) environments, widely adopted across healthcare, smart homes, and industry due to its cost-effectiveness. However, the dynamic nature of IoT frequently alters data distributions, affecting MLaaS stability, while periodic MLaaS updates further introduce performance drift. Unlike traditional ML systems, MLaaS clients operate as black-box users without access to internal data or parameters, making drift detection particularly challenging. To address this, we propose a novel MLaaS Performance Drift Detection framework for IoT environments. The framework first employs an MLaaS extraction model that learns service behavior from input-output pairs and identifies prediction-influenced features. Building on this, the proposed MLaaS Performance Drift Detection (MPDD) model jointly captures variations in input data and MLaaS behavior. We further design an Adaptive-Temporal Performance Drift Detection Mechanism (APDDM) that dynamically adjusts monitoring frequency based on behavioral and data variations, enabling timely drift detection for effective service management. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that MPDD achieves up to 22-25% accuracy improvement over baseline drift detection methods. APDDM provides an average accuracy gain of approximately 4% and reduces the miss detection rate by around 9% compared to fixed-interval monitoring.
2608.18555.paper_summary_zh: 機器學習即服務（MLaaS）是一種強大的雲端範式，使數據驅動的智能應用在物聯網（IoT）環境中得以實現，因其成本效益而被廣泛應用於醫療保健、智能家居和工業領域。然而，物聯網的動態特性經常改變數據分佈，影響MLaaS的穩定性，而定期的MLaaS更新進一步引入了性能漂移。與傳統的機器學習系統不同，MLaaS客戶端作為黑箱用戶運行，無法訪問內部數據或參數，使得漂移檢測特別具有挑戰性。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個針對物聯網環境的創新MLaaS性能漂移檢測框架。該框架首先使用一個MLaaS提取模型，從輸入-輸出對中學習服務行為並識別受預測影響的特徵。在此基礎上，所提出的MLaaS性能漂移檢測（MPDD）模型共同捕捉輸入數據和MLaaS行為的變化。我們進一步設計了一個自適應時間性能漂移檢測機制（APDDM），根據行為和數據變化動態調整監控頻率，實現及時的漂移檢測，以便有效的服務管理。在真實世界數據集上的大量實驗表明，MPDD在基線漂移檢測方法上實現了高達22-25%的準確度提升。與固定間隔監控相比，APDDM提供了約4%的平均準確度增益，並將漏檢率降低了約9%。
